name: newera_arcturus
label: One-off NewEra (PHOENIX) model for Arcturus and its alpha-enhanced comparison node
contents: bin_rf_standalone .npz, 380-1000 nm (0.02 nm) and 380-2500 nm (0.1 nm) ranges
sources: NewEra one-off page https://portal.nersc.gov/project/newera/phoenix/one-off/arcturus/ (README.md there; computed at NERSC 2026-11-24 with P. Hauschildt's executable and templates): lte04286-1.66-0.5.alpha=+0.4 with microturbulence 1.7 km/s and 1.08 Msun (Ramirez & Allende Prieto 2011 parameters), and the grid-settings node lte04300-1.50-0.5.alpha=+0.4
notes: Spherical, LTE, 1D; [M/H] -0.5 with a uniform [alpha/Fe] +0.4. R_eff = 25.46 Rsun, R_outer / R_eff = 1.0418; the tables' own reference radius (tau = 1 at 1.2 um, r_outer_over_tau1 = 1.0338) is 1.0077 R_eff.

The one-off directory hosts no manifest.json: `remote.files` is the manifest (sizes and SHA-256 of the files downloaded 2026-11-24). If the tables are re-binned at NERSC the hashes here must be updated.
Kept apart from data/newera_redclump because NewEraGrid.scan keys tables by (T_eff, log g, [M/H]) only: the alpha-enhanced node would collide with the solar-scaled lte04300-1.50-0.5.

Directory search order: $HBTSIM_NEWERA_ARCTURUS_DIR, then this `path` relative to the current directory, then <data_dir>/newera_arcturus. `hbtsim data fetch --target arcturus` downloads the Arcturus table.
